resources.string: Ready. Look for a thin, faint bar on the right edge of your screen, a little above the middle (touch and hold, then drag, to move it). Tap it to open your phone\'s own volume panel, or drag along it to change the volume, in any app.

EdgeVol uses Android\'s Accessibility service only to keep its small volume handle on the screen edge, above other apps. It does not read, collect or send anything on your screen, and it has no internet access. The handle only asks your phone to show or change the volume.
Open your phone\'s own volume panel to check that it works.

On Android 13 and later, apps installed outside an app store can\'t use Accessibility until you allow restricted settings. If the EdgeVol switch is greyed out, follow these steps, then come back and tap Enable.
